goAnywhere.label: GoAnywhere 完了したジョブ
goAnywhere.openHint: GoAnywhere 監査ログ > ジョブログ > 完了したジョブ。日付範囲: Today、プロジェクト名で絞り込み、開始時間 ▼(新しい順)、列に「解決済み」を追加(異常終了の行だけ No)

fingerprint._ok_doc: 解決済み (resolved) is a column the operator adds to the view; without it a failed job (red icon, not in the text) cannot be told from a good one, so a page without the column is the wrong page.

goAnywhere._refresh_doc: Why Tab x5 (from the Ctrl+A page text, not seen on screen -- operator 10/21 asked): Esc leaves the focus on the heading text フィルタリングする, which is not itself a control; the page text has a TAB right after it (the panel's collapse icon), so the Tabs are (1) that icon, (2) 日付範囲, (3) プロジェクト名, (4) 詳細, (5) 更新. By hand the icon is easy not to count. If the panel changes, change the count here or in ebi.local.json.
jobLogRecipe: find:ジョブログをダウンロードする
goAnywhere._near_doc: the wider window browser.wait_for also watches (nearAny): a row this far outside windowBefore..windowAfter means the time typed is off, not the page late -- verify.nearest_time proposes that row's start and a gate asks.
goAnywhere._crop_doc: the 'part above' of the list for Teams (p4): panel title down to the job's rows. Pixels relative to the screen with the window MAXIMIZED on a 1920x1080 display (measured on the operator's full-screen capture). insetX/insetY undo the off-screen frame of a maximized window.
goAnywhere._deselect_doc: after Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C the selection is dropped with a find (only the small label stays selected) -- no click: a click at fixed pixels can land on a link when the display scale is not 100%. deselectAt is kept for reference, unused by the track.
goAnywhere._jobLogRecipe_doc: on the job page: find the 'download the job log' button and Enter on it; then jobLogBackKeys (Tab Tab Enter = the page's own return button) goes back to the list. NEVER the browser's Back (Alt+Left): the list is a posted form and Back shows 'resend the form?' (ERR_CACHE_MISS). Override either in ebi.local.json if the page changes.

jenkinsReport.label: Jenkins data/report
jenkinsReport.openHint: Jenkins の userContent logs/files/<system>/data/report/ を開く(別ウィンドウ)
jenkinsReport._mark_doc: a box on the received file row in the end-scrolled screenshot: rows are found as bands of BLUE link text in the name column (strip), counted from the bottom against the page text; the box spans name .. 参照 (measured on the delivered evidence screenshots: x 445, width 892, rows 20 px apart).
jenkinsReport._endText_doc: the footer under the LAST row: only in the copied text once the whole list (~4000 rows) has rendered. readyText (参照) is on every row, so it matches a half-loaded page -- 10-09 the evidence run copied and screenshotted a list that stopped short of the end.
jenkinsReport._deselect_doc: the blank left margin of the 1410x807 Jenkins window
